en: YOU CO-SIGNED A LOAN FOR YOUR COUSIN. YOUR COUSIN HAS LEFT TOWN. THE LOAN HAS NOT. YOU OWE %s AND HAVE %d DAYS. PULL-TABS ARE THE ONLY THING YOU WERE EVER GOOD AT.

en: PAID. EVERY LAST CENT, AND THE INTEREST ON THE INTEREST ON THE INTEREST. THEY SEND A FRUIT BASKET. YOU ARE FREE. YOU STILL ONLY KNOW PULL-TABS.
zh: 还清了。每一分钱，连同利息的利息的利息。他们送来一个果篮。你自由了。你还是只会开 pull-tabs。

en: TIME IS UP AND THE MONEY IS NOT THERE. THEY TAKE THE CAR. YOU DID NOT HAVE A CAR. THEY TAKE SOMEBODY'S CAR AND SAY IT IS ON YOU.
zh: 期限到了，钱没凑够。他们把车开走了。你没有车。他们开走了别人的车，说这笔算你头上。
